description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing common setup such as logging initialization. It extends FragmentActivity and sets up a logging chain using custom LogWrapper and Log classes.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for activities that include logging setup and basic lifecycle management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the FragmentActivity's onCreate method; currently only calls super implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the FragmentActivity's onStart method; calls initializeLogging to set up logging when activity starts.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain using a LogWrapper and logs a 'Ready' message.
